summary: Gray Media filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing a Seventh Amendment to its Fifth Amended and Restated Senior Credit Facility, executed October 8, 2026, with Wells Fargo as administrative agent. The amendment creates a new $600 million Tranche G term loan maturing July 15, 2030, and reduces revolver commitments from $750 million to $680 million while extending revolver maturity to July 15, 2030. Term Loan G proceeds repaid part of the Term D Loan, leaving $150 million outstanding. Springing maturities tie to Term D, Term Loan G and 2029 1L Notes. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation; watch for covenant headroom, leverage and maturity-wall management.
